basis: Current November 2026 ranking reconstructed retrospectively; complete-data subset introduces coverage-selection bias. Not a point-in-time Top 50, fund, executable offer or net return.

cadence.method: First available archive plus actual calendar month-end snapshots; not daily history.
Actual daily archives reused from the Modern100 cache.

rankingProof.definition: Specific English-catalogue single-card printings with positive TCGplayer/TCGCSV mixed-condition USD market guides. Sealed/accessories/lots/nonstandard-size, explicit foreign-language issues, named trophy/winner awards, player-placement/professor-program awards and World Championship deck reproductions are outside this main universe. Ordinary retail and staff promos remain included.
rankingProof.method: Descending marketPrice, then groupId/productId/subTypeName for deterministic ties. All price subtypes considered; no low/mid asking-price substitutes.

universeSummary: Screened 45,649 source rows across 220 Pokémon groups. The 50 highest eligible, matched English Raw guides are ranked here; there are no unresolved higher-priced rows in this defined universe. 875 rows without market guides remain unranked. Ordinary staff and retail promos are included; named trophy/winner awards, placement awards, reproductions and sealed products are excluded. Sale frequency is not measured.

unsupportedInitialRange.reason: Provider explicitly states archives before 2024-02-08 do not exist. No substitute or synthetic history supplied.
